authority: PI, 2026-09-01, opening a new program immediately upon closing the latent compression ladder after V4
name_note: Working name proposed by the executing agent. The PI's phrasing was 'a new causal-distillation program'; the name here is deliberately broader because Phase 2 CHOOSES the mechanism and distillation is only one of the candidates. Trivially renameable before any result exists.

TARGET.gate: V(z0,A) > V(z1,A)  AND  V(z1,B) > V(z0,B), with BOTH paired-bootstrap LCB95 > 0
TARGET.unchanged_from_the_ladder: deliberately. The bar is the same bar V1, OG-PSP, V3 and V4 were scored against, so a success here is comparable to those four failures rather than measured on a friendlier ruler.
TARGET.estimator: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level episode outcomes, n_boot 20000, alpha 0.05, rng seed 7 -- the project's unchanged convention

THE_CHANGE_IN_OBJECTIVE.old: make the latents encode different strategies
THE_CHANGE_IN_OBJECTIVE.new: make the latents encode differences that causally change winning
THE_CHANGE_IN_OBJECTIVE.why: PI, 2026-09-01: 'distinct policies != distinct strategic value.' The ladder achieved latent differentiation, specialist-like trajectory identity, private actor capacity and private critic heads, and still returned delta_A = delta_B = 0. Adding further separation attacks the wrong problem. The model already knows how to be different; it does not know which differences matter.
THE_CHANGE_IN_OBJECTIVE.what_makes_this_tractable: SAPPO already established that the environment SUPPORTS the crossover: pi_A wins preferentially on Pole A and pi_B on Pole B. Two policies that work already exist. The question is which of their decisions carry the payoff, and that is measurable.

INHERITED_AS_SETTLED.rule: These are results, not assumptions, and this program does not re-litigate them.
INHERITED_AS_SETTLED.latent_differentiation: achieved, OG-PSP, 6.39x on the matched CALIB ruler
INHERITED_AS_SETTLED.trajectory_identity: achieved, V3, both poles, R ~1.0 vs teachers
INHERITED_AS_SETTLED.private_critic_heads: achieved, V4, both heads live, row balance 0.9997

PHASE_0_REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE.claim: (seed, action prefix) -> s_t is a function: replaying a prefix reproduces the state
PHASE_0_REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE.why_first: The whole program rests on matched causal branching, and there is NO state save/restore anywhere in gpu_env -- no snapshot, no deepcopy hook, no restore. Prefix replay is the only route to matched states that does not add env surface, and it is an untested assumption. Everything downstream is worthless if it does not hold.
PHASE_0_REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE.status: HARD GATE. If replay equivalence fails, Phase 1 does not start and the program returns to the PI for a decision about adding state restore to the environment.

PHASE_1_MATCHED_CAUSAL_BRANCHING.goal: locate where the specialist distinction actually changes the outcome
PHASE_1_MATCHED_CAUSAL_BRANCHING.method: from each replayed state s_t, branch pi_A, pi_B, z0, z1 under matched continuation randomness; estimate Q on each pole

PHASE_2_CLASSIFY_THE_FAILURE.rule: This diagnostic DECIDES the next algorithm. No more guessing.

taxonomy.visitation: the policy rarely reaches the states where the specialists have an advantage
taxonomy.timing: it reaches them at the wrong moment
taxonomy.decision: it reaches the same state and selects the wrong action
taxonomy.sequence: the first action is right and the following subsequence collapses
taxonomy.optimization: the actor behaves correctly and PPO systematically erodes those decisions

PHASE_2_CLASSIFY_THE_FAILURE.leading_suspect_from_the_ladder: sequence. V3 produced strong trajectory identity with absent payoff identity, which fits a policy reproducing the SHAPE of a strategy while missing a handful of decisive subsequences.

PHASE_3_MECHANISM_CHOSEN_BY_PHASE_2.if_decision: advantage-weighted specialist distillation: L = L_PPO + lambda * E[w(s) * L_teacher(s,z)], w(s) = f(delta_Q(s)), so a disagreement that does not change winning gets little or no pressure
PHASE_3_MECHANISM_CHOSEN_BY_PHASE_2.if_sequence: distil critical options/segments (s_t, a_t..a_t+k) under a temporally extended objective rather than one-step imitation
PHASE_3_MECHANISM_CHOSEN_BY_PHASE_2.if_visitation: occupancy or segment-level objectives matching d^z0 to d^piA, but ONLY over regions the branching analysis showed to matter for payoff
PHASE_3_MECHANISM_CHOSEN_BY_PHASE_2.if_timing_or_optimization: to be specified when the classification exists; not pre-guessed here
PHASE_3_MECHANISM_CHOSEN_BY_PHASE_2.escalation_if_none_of_it_works: explicit hierarchical structure -- per-latent option policies, separate recurrent state, separate trunks -- and at the extreme, compress the ENSEMBLE rather than the strategies. PI: 'The engineering target is crossover, not ideological purity about how many tensors must be shared.'

STANDING_RULES.note: PI, 2026-09-01: 'No matter what' should mean we keep searching, not that we contaminate the evidence.
rules: fresh training seeds for every attempt
fresh EVAL block for every attempt
terminal checkpoint only; no checkpoint shopping, all periodic hashes recorded
no tuning against an EVAL block that has been read
no threshold chosen after seeing payoff
STANDING_RULES.namespace_for_this_program: 115xxxxx, disjoint from every block the ladder used
STANDING_RULES.why_this_does_not_slow_us_down: It prevents eventually getting a 'success' that cannot be trusted. A crossover result obtained by tuning against a read EVAL block would be worth less than the four honest failures already on record.

WHAT_THIS_PROGRAM_MAY_NOT_DO: rewrite, repair or reinterpret V1, OG-PSP, V3 or V4
choose the Phase 3 mechanism before Phase 2 classifies the failure
select a delta_Q threshold after seeing the delta_Q distribution
treat a Phase 0 or Phase 1 diagnostic as a payoff result
claim crossover on anything other than the frozen gate above

RELATIONSHIP_TO_THE_ICRA_SUBMISSION.the_paper: SAPPO with V3 as the centerpiece (trajectory identity confirmed, payoff absent) and V4 as a second architecturally distinct route to the same absence
RELATIONSHIP_TO_THE_ICRA_SUBMISSION.the_2026_09_05_wall: governs what may enter THIS submission, not whether new work runs

PROVENANCE.environment_finding_that_shaped_Phase_0: no state save/restore exists in gpu_env; prefix replay is the only matched-state route that adds no env surface
